svg.title: Compilation energy payback horizons, shared .rlib prelude cache, and name-free reuse soundness
svg.desc: Left: log-log lifecycle energy E_compile + N * E_run (RAPL core reported_j) across compiler tiers including Wave 5 pre-compiled librce_rt.rlib (2.81 J vs 56.29 J monolithic, 20.1x compile reduction, N* = 1,079 vs 31,080). Right top: -O2 to -O3 payback outcomes across 20 kernels. Right bottom: E5-Scale soundness across 500 verified semantic mutants and E4-Prelude savings.
svg.text: E4-Energy, E4-Prelude (.rlib) & E5-Scale: Payback Horizons (N*) and Reuse Soundness
